toegepas.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
toegepas.voor: Die deur sou die hele week toe bly.
toegepas.na: Die deur sal die hele week toe bly.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The story is told in the present tense, so 'sal' fits better than the past-future 'sou'.
toegepas.fout: 'sou' is a past-future that clashes with the present-tense narration
toegepas.rede_keurder: In a story told in the present, 'sal' matches the tense and keeps the meaning that the door stays shut all week.

toegepas.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
toegepas.voor: Nou lê die geld in sy sak en daar
toegepas.na: Nou lê die geld in sy sak, en daar
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'die geld ... lê' and 'daar is' each have their own subject and verb, so the comma before 'en' is required.

toegepas.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
toegepas.voor: is hy honger en hy sit alleen
toegepas.na: is hy honger en sit hy alleen
toegepas.rede_vinder: Repeating 'hy' before the verb sounds wooden; inversion after the shared opener reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: repeated 'hy' after 'en' reads stiffly under the shared time opener
toegepas.rede_keurder: Inversion lets 'Teen die tweede pouse' govern both verbs, which is the natural written form, with no change in who does what.

toegepas.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
toegepas.voor: breek haar brood in twee stukke en
toegepas.na: breek haar brood in twee en
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'In twee breek' is the idiom; 'stukke' followed by 'helfte' is redundant.
toegepas.fout: 'in twee stukke breek' loosens the fixed expression and sits awkwardly before 'helfte'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'In twee breek' is the idiomatic Afrikaans and says exactly the same thing.

toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Dit is' and 'Thabang se honger is' are separate clauses; the protected 'brood met kaas' is untouched.

toegepas.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
toegepas.voor: Thabang eet sy bord vol en daar bly
toegepas.na: Thabang eet 'n bord vol, en daar bly
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Sy bord vol eet' is not idiomatic (one dishes a plate full or eats it empty); also adds the AWS clause comma.
toegepas.fout: 'sy bord vol eet' is not idiomatic, and the AWS clause comma is missing
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Bord vol eet' is the natural expression for eating a plateful, the meaning is unchanged, and the comma is required.

toegepas.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was

toegepas.rede_keurder: Commas between the list items with one final 'en' is the normal form, and every item stays.

laat_vaar.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
laat_vaar.voor: Zanele kom sit langs hom met haar kos.
laat_vaar.na: Zanele kom sit met haar kos langs hom.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Afrikaans puts manner before place, so 'met haar kos' comes before 'langs hom'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original order reads naturally in the story; the proposal is a lateral reordering.

laat_vaar.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
laat_vaar.voor: is die kos nog koel teen die ys
laat_vaar.na: is die kos teen die ys nog koel
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Placing 'teen die ys' before 'nog koel' makes clear it is the ice that keeps the food cool.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original already makes clear the food is cool against the ice; moving the phrase only makes it read differently.

laat_vaar.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Gaan staan' marks taking up a position, which clashes with 'n lang ruk'; plain 'staan' describes the lasting state.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Gaan staan' carries his walking up to the shelf and repeats the story's own motif; plain 'staan' loses that movement.

laat_vaar.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
laat_vaar.voor: is die bord weg van die snoepie se deur af
laat_vaar.na: is die bord van die snoepie se deur af weg
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans the predicate 'weg' naturally closes the clause after the 'van ... af' phrase.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Weg van ... af' is natural Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral reordering.
